name: colvet-backend
description: ColVet Digital — API (Express + Prisma). Mismo stack que Psicole.

scripts.setup: prisma generate && prisma db push --skip-generate && node --env-file-if-exists=.env prisma/seed.js
scripts.test: DATABASE_URL=file:./test.db prisma db push --skip-generate >/dev/null && DATABASE_URL=file:./test.db node prisma/seed.js && DATABASE_URL=file:./test.db node --test tests/*.test.js
